commits.author: Marco Andronaco
commits.subject: fix: capitalize the first letter of grouped action summaries
commits.body:
The per-tool count phrases (e.g. "letti 2 file") are written lowercase
so they read naturally when joined mid-sentence after "Thought for
Xs, ...". When there's no reasoning piece, one of them ends up first
and the whole summary started lowercase. Capitalize the joined result
instead of each piece.
